scope: strict ledger load plus duplicate validation; command-path microprobe, not whole diagnosis or GUI
build_profile: debug, existing checkout library; identical binary for both variants
method: One warmup each; 20 alternating paired rounds; 12 actual strict ledger loads per sample in both variants. Before repeats generation_ledger_integrity_ok on every returned immutable ledger; after consumes the validated result directly. Verify the initial and final entire loaded ledger and record/ledger hashes are identical. The production diagnosis is independently covered by its existing actual-reader projection regression with a thread-local full-validation counter.
limitations: Shared-host debug command-path timings are observations without a timing assertion, not shipping release CPU, whole-diagnosis or GUI measurements.
Both variants run the same strict loader and preserve its filesystem and authority validation. Only the immediate duplicate validation of that heap value differs.
The four-generation fixture does not establish large-ledger scaling or real eight-agent sixty-minute CPU/RSS/timeout and PM-prompt acceptance.
Parent AC-1/2/3 and other owners long-duration memory acceptance remain unproven and unchecked.
